pr_title: Added docs about `MinimalPlugins` looping as fast as possible.
pr_body:
This also includes suggestions and an example on how to limit the loop speed.
Fixes #17147.

issue_context.title: Need Doc to explain why `The loop for MinimalPlugins runs as fast as possible`
issue_context.body:
## How can Bevy's documentation be improved?

Empty MinimalPlugins cause high cpu usage，could makes new user confusing
```
App::new().add_plugins(MinimalPlugins).run();
```

according to [this post](https://discord.com/channels/691052431525675048/1310310792368750622)
`The loop for MinimalPlugins runs as fast as possible`


I think [doc](https://docs.rs/bevy/latest/bevy/struct.MinimalPlugins.html)  need to explain why, and how to control the fps.
